prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: the supplied stone paving material panel. The current stones are far too huge for the game. Change ONLY the scale/density of the material: each paving stone must become FOUR TIMES SMALLER in width AND height, so the complete same-sized panel contains about sixteen times as many stones. Make this change unmistakable. Maintain the same grey-brown low-saturation palette and flat orthographic top-down paving; most stones should be tiny quiet cobbles, modest rectangular flagstones mixed in, with hairline joints and sparse moss. Intended world canvas 1040x780 pixels; human sprite only 30 pixels tall, typical cobble 8-14 pixels wide and 5-10 pixels tall. Full-bleed uniform continuous dense ground texture, not a macro close-up, do not preserve the old large stone layout. Crisp pixel clusters, much less grain/noise on individual stones, low contrast, neutral even illumination, no dark outline grid. No visible tiling seams or mirrored motifs; no objects, scenery, characters, text, water, vignette, borders or lighting effects. Keep landscape 4:3 composition.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: the supplied wooden floor material panel. Its boards are far too wide and too long relative to a human. Change ONLY the material unit scale: each board must become FOUR TIMES NARROWER and FOUR TIMES SHORTER, so the complete same-sized panel contains about sixteen times as many boards. Make this change unmistakable. Keep the same dull earthy dark brown weathered oak palette, same horizontal orientation and uniform neutral illumination. Full-bleed dense continuous wooden flooring viewed orthographically from above, not a macro close-up. For a 1040x780 world-pixel canvas and a human 30 pixels tall, each plank should be about 5-9 pixels thick and 35-70 pixels long. Many varied staggered end joints, tiny restrained knots, delicate grain, quiet worn surfaces, thin dark seams without bold black outlines. Deliberate crisp game pixel clusters, no perspective convergence, no visible tiling/mirroring, no aligned vertical joints. No props, walls, characters, text, borders, vignette, gradients, baked light or shadows. Keep landscape 4:3 composition.
